trial.question: How quickly should an urgent complaint be escalated?

claims.statement: The workflow supports evidence-first employee policy lookup with knowledge-owner escalation.
A synthetic local corpus can produce a chunk-cited answer without a paid API.
Twelve reviewed queries and governance branches have deterministic tests.
Missing, stale, conflicting, future-dated and sensitive evidence paths stop answer composition.
Retrieval components were screened with exact version and license provenance; neither was forced into the lexical default.
A synthetic common-credential bypass report is linked to a normalized sensitive-request boundary and regression tests.
Production gaps and non-adoption conditions are explicit.

boundaries: Synthetic corpus only; no claim of enterprise retrieval accuracy or real adoption.
Metadata filters are retrieval controls, not authorization or tenant isolation.
A real pilot requires document ownership, access control, ingestion review and accountable human verification.
